title: Everyone forgot that moment. Except you. 😬 #shorts
description:
The waiter said "Enjoy your meal." You said "You too." Four years later, the waiter has forgotten. Everyone at the table has forgotten. The only person still replaying it… is you. 😬 Psychologists call it the spotlight effect: most people never even noticed.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/fN20EY-EMLk

#psychology #cringe #shorts
